```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# ==========================================================================================================
# FLYSHOOT Observer Comparison Tripreport
# Updated: April 2026
#
# Compares self-sampling data with observer (waarnemer) estimates for a single trip.
# Two comparisons are produced:
#   1. Species composition of landings (self-sampling vs. observer)
#   2. Total discards and total landings per haul (self-sampling vs. observer)
#
# Requires:
#   - Standard FLYSHOOT data (haul, kisten) loaded via load_flyshoot_data()
#   - Observer Excel file (waarnemer vangst) with sheets "totaal" and "per trek"
# ==========================================================================================================

# ==========================================================================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ==========================================================================================================

library(withr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(arrow)
library(jsonlite)
library(glue)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(captioner)
library(readxl)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      comment = "", fig.width = 10)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(ft.align = "left")

# ==========================================================================================================
# PARAMETER HANDLING
# ==========================================================================================================

setvessel   <- getOption("flyshoot.vessel",      default = "SCH99")
startdate   <- getOption("flyshoot.startdate",   default = lubridate::dmy("08/02/2026"))
enddate     <- getOption("flyshoot.enddate",     default = lubridate::dmy("12/02/2026"))
lang        <- getOption("flyshoot.lang",        default = "nl")
max_species <- getOption("flyshoot.max_species", default = 12)

# Path to the observer Excel file — update if needed
observer_file <- getOption(
  "flyshoot.observer_file",
  default = "C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/FLYSHOOT - General/tripdata/SCH99/SCH99 2026_277 waarnemer vangst.xlsx"
)

cat(glue("\n  ▶ Rendering vessel: {setvessel} | {format(startdate,'%d/%m/%Y')} – {format(enddate,'%d/%m/%Y')}\n"))

# ==========================================================================================================
# LANGUAGE STRINGS — all UI text goes through txt("key")
# ==========================================================================================================

strings <- list(
  nl = list(
    cap_samenvatting   = "Samenvatting van de reis",
    col_trip           = "Trip",
    col_from           = "Van",
    col_to             = "Tot",
    col_days           = "Dagen",
    col_hauls          = "Trekken",
    col_hauls_day      = "Tr/dag",
    col_species        = "Soort",
    col_code           = "Code",
    col_total_kg       = "Totaal (kg)",
    col_ss_kg          = "Self-sampling (kg)",
    col_obs_kg         = "Waarnemer (kg)",
    col_diff_kg        = "Verschil (kg)",
    col_diff_pct       = "Verschil (%)",
    total_row          = "TOTAAL",
    hdr_report         = "Reisoverzicht (waarnemer vergelijking)",
    plot_trip_lbl      = "Reis:",
    hdr_generated      = "Rapport gegenereerd",
    lbl_selfsampling   = "Self-sampling",
    lbl_observer       = "Waarnemer",
    lbl_aanvoer        = "Aanvoer",
    lbl_discards       = "Discards",
    xlab_haul          = "Trek",
    ylab_weight        = "Gewicht (kg)",
    ylab_pct           = "Aandeel aanvoer (%)",
    cap_species_comp   = "Soortsamenstelling aanvoer: self-sampling vs. waarnemer (%)",
    cap_haul_comp      = "Totale discards en aanvoer per trek: self-sampling vs. waarnemer (kg)",
    cap_species_table  = "Vergelijking aanvoer per soort: self-sampling vs. waarnemer (kg)"
  ),
  en = list(
    cap_samenvatting   = "Trip summary",
    col_trip           = "Trip",
    col_from           = "From",
    col_to             = "To",
    col_days           = "Days",
    col_hauls          = "Hauls",
    col_hauls_day      = "Hauls/day",
    col_species        = "Species",
    col_code           = "Code",
    col_total_kg       = "Total (kg)",
    col_ss_kg          = "Self-sampling (kg)",
    col_obs_kg         = "Observer (kg)",
    col_diff_kg        = "Difference (kg)",
    col_diff_pct       = "Difference (%)",
    total_row          = "TOTAL",
    hdr_report         = "Tripreport (observer comparison)",
    plot_trip_lbl      = "Trip:",
    hdr_generated      = "Report generated",
    lbl_selfsampling   = "Self-sampling",
    lbl_observer       = "Observer",
    lbl_aanvoer        = "Landings",
    lbl_discards       = "Discards",
    xlab_haul          = "Haul",
    ylab_weight        = "Weight (kg)",
    ylab_pct           = "Share of landings (%)",
    cap_species_comp   = "Species composition of landings: self-sampling vs. observer (%)",
    cap_haul_comp      = "Total discards and landings per haul: self-sampling vs. observer (kg)",
    cap_species_table  = "Landings by species comparison: self-sampling vs. observer (kg)"
  )
)
txt <- function(key) {
  v <- strings[[lang]][[key]]
  if (is.null(v)) stop("Unknown key: ", key)
  v
}

# ==========================================================================================================
# PROJECT ROOT & CONFIG
# ==========================================================================================================

project_root <- Sys.getenv("FLYSHOOT_PROJECT")
if (project_root == "") {
  stop(
    "Environment variable FLYSHOOT_PROJECT is not set.\n\n",
    "  1. Run:  usethis::edit_r_environ()\n",
    "  2. Add:  FLYSHOOT_PROJECT=C:/GIT/flyshoot\n",
    "  3. Save, then restart R: Session > Restart R\n",
    "  4. Knit again."
  )
}
p <- function(...) file.path(project_root, ...)

# Copy Word template next to the Rmd so pandoc can find it
local({
  template_src <- p("report_template.dotx")
  rmd_input    <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(rmd_input) && file.exists(template_src)) {
    template_dest <- file.path(dirname(rmd_input), "report_template.dotx")
    if (!identical(template_src, template_dest))
      file.copy(template_src, template_dest, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
})

# Guard against output file being open in Word
local({
  rmd_input <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(rmd_input)) {
    docx_out <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(rmd_input), ".docx")
    if (file.exists(docx_out)) {
      locked <- tryCatch({ con <- file(docx_out, open = "ab"); close(con); FALSE },
                         error = function(e) TRUE)
      if (locked) stop("Output file is open in Word — please close it before knitting:\n  ", docx_out)
    }
  }
})

if (!file.exists(p("config.json")))
  stop("config.json not found at: ", p("config.json"), "\nPlease run 00_setup.R first.")

config <- jsonlite::read_json(p("config.json"))

# Source into the global environment (local = FALSE) so all functions, including
# parse_marelec_species(), are available in every subsequent chunk.
# withr::with_dir sets the working directory so plain file.exists("config.json")
# checks inside the sourced files resolve correctly.
withr::with_dir(project_root, {
  source(p("R", "harmonized", "01_flyshoot_functions.R"), local = FALSE)
  source(p("R", "harmonized", "02_storage_functions.R"), local = FALSE)
  source(p("R", "FLYSHOOT utils.R"),                     local = FALSE)
})

# ==========================================================================================================
# ASFIS SPECIES TABLE  (needed for Dutch/English names)
# ==========================================================================================================

asfis <- loadRData(file.path(config$spatial_data, "asfis.RData")) %>%
  rename_with(tolower)

species_name_col <- if (lang == "nl") "dutchname" else "englishname"

# ==========================================================================================================
# CAPTIONER SETUP
# ==========================================================================================================

tab_prefix <- if (lang == "nl") "Tabel " else "Table "
fig_prefix <- if (lang == "nl") "Figuur " else "Figure "
tab_nums   <- captioner::captioner(prefix = tab_prefix, levels = 1, type = "n", infix = ".")
fig_nums   <- captioner::captioner(prefix = fig_prefix, levels = 1, type = "n", infix = ".")

# flextable defaults
flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family  = "Calibri",
  font.size    = 9,
  border.color = "#AAAAAA",
  padding      = 3,
  theme_fun    = theme_vanilla
)

# ==========================================================================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ==========================================================================================================

safe_load <- function(type) {
  tryCatch(
    load_flyshoot_data(type, vessel_ids = setvessel),
    error = function(e) { message(glue("  ⚠ Could not load {type}: {e$message}")); tibble() }
  )
}

haul   <- safe_load("haul")
kisten <- safe_load("kisten")
elog   <- safe_load("elog")

# ==========================================================================================================
# TRIP RESOLUTION
# ==========================================================================================================

resolve_settrip <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(vessel %in% setvessel, date >= startdate, date <= enddate) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(trip_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(trip_id)
}

settrip <- if (nrow(elog) > 0 && length(resolve_settrip(elog)) > 0) {
  resolve_settrip(elog)
} else if (nrow(haul) > 0 && length(resolve_settrip(haul)) > 0) {
  resolve_settrip(haul)
} else if (nrow(kisten) > 0 && length(resolve_settrip(kisten)) > 0) {
  resolve_settrip(kisten)
} else {
  stop(glue("No data found for vessel {setvessel} between ",
            "{format(startdate,'%d/%m/%Y')} and {format(enddate,'%d/%m/%Y')}"))
}

# ==========================================================================================================
# FILTER TO TRIP
# ==========================================================================================================

harmonise_species <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(x == "SQC" ~ "SQR", TRUE ~ x)

h <- if (nrow(haul) > 0) {
  haul %>% dplyr::filter(vessel %in% setvessel, trip_id %in% settrip)
} else { tibble() }

m <- if (nrow(kisten) > 0) {
  kisten %>%
    dplyr::filter(vessel %in% setvessel, trip_id %in% settrip) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      species_code = toupper(species_code),
      species_code = harmonise_species(species_code)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
} else { tibble() }

has_haul   <- nrow(h) > 0
has_kisten <- nrow(m) > 0

if (!has_haul && !has_kisten)
  stop(glue("No haul or kisten data for vessel {setvessel}, trip(s) {paste(settrip, collapse=',')}"))

# Derive report date range from haul data
report_start <- if (has_haul) min(h$date, na.rm = TRUE) else startdate
report_end   <- if (has_haul) max(h$date, na.rm = TRUE) else enddate

# ==========================================================================================================
# OBSERVER DATA — waarnemer vangst
# ==========================================================================================================

if (!file.exists(observer_file))
  stop("Observer file not found:\n  ", observer_file,
       "\n\nUpdate the 'observer_file' path in the parameter section above.")

# Sheet "totaal": total landings + discards per species for the whole trip
wn_totaal_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  observer_file,
  sheet      = "totaal",
  col_names  = TRUE,
  .name_repair = ~make.names(., unique = TRUE)
)

# Resolve observer Dutch species names to FAO 3-alpha codes.
# Strategy (two-step, most robust to avoid scoping issues):
#   1. parse_marelec_species() — the standard FLYSHOOT name parser
#   2. Fuzzy fallback via asfis dutchname lookup (case-insensitive) for any
#      names that step 1 could not resolve (e.g. abbreviated or variant names)
#   3. If still unresolved, flag with "?" prefix for manual inspection

# Build asfis Dutch-name lookup (lowercased for case-insensitive matching)
asfis_nl_lkp <- asfis %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dutchname), dutchname != "") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dutchname_lower = tolower(trimws(dutchname))) %>%
  dplyr::select(species_code = species, dutchname_lower) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(dutchname_lower, .keep_all = TRUE)

wn_totaal <- wn_totaal_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    species_name_nl_raw = species_name_nl,
    species_name_upper  = toupper(trimws(species_name_nl)),
    # Step 1: parse_marelec_species()
    species_code_parsed = parse_marelec_species(species_name_upper)$species_code
  ) %>%
  # Step 2: asfis Dutch-name fallback for rows that step 1 left empty
  dplyr::mutate(dutchname_lower = tolower(trimws(species_name_nl))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(asfis_nl_lkp, by = "dutchname_lower") %>%
  dplyr::rename(species_code_asfis = species_code) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    species_code = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(species_code_parsed) & species_code_parsed != "" ~ species_code_parsed,
      !is.na(species_code_asfis)                              ~ species_code_asfis,
      # Step 3: flag unresolved names
      TRUE ~ paste0("?", toupper(substr(trimws(species_name_nl), 1, 3)))
    ),
    source = "observer"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dutchname_lower, -species_code_parsed, -species_code_asfis)

# Sheet "per trek": landings + discards per haul
# "#N/A" cells (hauls with no observer coverage) become NA after as.numeric()
wn_pertrek <- readxl::read_excel(
  observer_file,
  sheet      = "per trek",
  col_names  = TRUE,
  .name_repair = ~make.names(., unique = TRUE)
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(haul_id = haul) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(discards, aanvoer),
                               ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = c(discards, aanvoer),
                      names_to  = "category",
                      values_to = "weight_kg") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight_kg)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source = "observer")

# ==========================================================================================================
# COMBINED DATASET 1: species composition of landings  (aligned on species_code)
# ==========================================================================================================

# Self-sampling: species-level landings from kisten, keyed on species_code
ss_totaal_aanvoer <- m %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species_code) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(weight_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = "aanvoer", source = "selfsampling")

# Observer: aanvoer rows only, already has species_code resolved above
obs_totaal_aanvoer <- wn_totaal %>%
  dplyr::filter(category == "aanvoer") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species_code) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(weight_kg = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(category = "aanvoer", source = "observer")

# Shared species label lookup: prefer Dutch/English name from asfis, fall back to code.
# Use a plain if() — lang is a scalar, not a vector, so dplyr::if_else() would fail here.
name_col <- if (lang == "nl") "dutchname" else "englishname"
sp_labels <- asfis %>%
  dplyr::select(species, dplyr::all_of(name_col)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(sp_label_raw = dplyr::all_of(name_col)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sp_label = dplyr::coalesce(sp_label_raw, as.character(species))) %>%
  dplyr::select(species_code = species, sp_label)

# Bind both sources and attach a consistent display label
comb_totaal_aanvoer <- dplyr::bind_rows(ss_totaal_aanvoer, obs_totaal_aanvoer) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(weight_kg = dplyr::coalesce(weight_kg, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sp_labels, by = "species_code") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sp_label = dplyr::coalesce(sp_label, species_code)   # fallback for unknown codes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * weight_kg / sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("selfsampling", "observer")))

# ==========================================================================================================
# COMBINED DATASET 2: discards + landings per haul
# ==========================================================================================================

# Self-sampling: total_catch_kg from haul; landings from kisten
ss_pertrek <- dplyr::left_join(
  h %>% dplyr::select(haul_id, total_catch_kg),
  m %>%
    dplyr::group_by(haul_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(aanvoer = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
  by = "haul_id"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    aanvoer  = dplyr::coalesce(aanvoer, 0),
    discards = pmax(total_catch_kg - aanvoer, 0)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = c(discards, aanvoer),
                      names_to  = "category",
                      values_to = "weight_kg") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight_kg)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source = "selfsampling")

comb_pertrek <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::select(ss_pertrek,  haul_id, category, weight_kg, source),
  dplyr::select(wn_pertrek,  haul_id, category, weight_kg, source)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source   = factor(source,   levels = c("selfsampling", "observer")),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("aanvoer", "discards"))
  )

# ==========================================================================================================
# COLOUR PALETTE
# ==========================================================================================================

pal_aanvoer  <- "#5B8DB8"   # steel blue  — landings
pal_discards <- "#D96B4F"   # terracotta  — discards
pal_header   <- "#D5E8F0"   # light blue  — table headers

# Shared flextable styling helper
style_ft <- function(ft, caption = NULL) {
  ft <- flextable::bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::bg(ft, part = "header", bg = pal_header)
  ft <- flextable::hline_top(ft, part = "header",
         border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E75B6", width = 1.5))
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, part = "header",
         border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E75B6", width = 1.5))
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, part = "body",
         border = officer::fp_border(color = "#AAAAAA", width = 0.5))
  ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
  ft <- flextable::set_table_properties(
    ft, opts_word = list(split = FALSE, keep_with_next = TRUE))
  if (!is.null(caption)) ft <- flextable::set_caption(ft, caption)
  ft
}
```

# `r paste(setvessel, collapse = ", ")` — `r txt("hdr_report")`

### `r txt("plot_trip_lbl")` `r paste(settrip, collapse = ", ")` | `r format(report_start, "%d %b")` – `r format(report_end, "%d %b %Y")`

`r txt("hdr_generated")`: `r format(Sys.time(), '%d/%m/%Y')`

```{r tab_samenvatting}

tab_nums("samenvatting", display = FALSE, caption = txt("cap_samenvatting"))

if (has_haul) {
  c1 <- h %>%
    dplyr::group_by(vessel, trip_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      nhauls    = dplyr::n_distinct(haul_id),
      startdate = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
      enddate   = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ndays       = as.numeric(difftime(enddate, startdate, units = "days")) + 1,
      hauls_p_day = round(nhauls / ndays, 1),
      startdate   = format(startdate, "%d/%m/%Y"),
      enddate     = format(enddate,   "%d/%m/%Y")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      !!txt("col_trip")      := trip_id,
      !!txt("col_from")      := startdate,
      !!txt("col_to")        := enddate,
      !!txt("col_days")      := ndays,
      !!txt("col_hauls")     := nhauls,
      !!txt("col_hauls_day") := hauls_p_day
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-vessel)

  style_ft(flextable::flextable(c1), caption = tab_nums("samenvatting"))
}
```

<!-- ########################################################################################## -->
<!-- Table 2: Landings by species — self-sampling vs. observer                                -->
<!-- ########################################################################################## -->

```{r tab_species_comparison}

tab_nums("species_comparison", display = FALSE, caption = txt("cap_species_table"))

# Build wide comparison table keyed on species_code — aligned across both sources
tbl_species <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ss_totaal_aanvoer %>% dplyr::select(species_code, weight_kg) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "selfsampling"),
  obs_totaal_aanvoer %>% dplyr::select(species_code, weight_kg) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(source = "observer")
) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = weight_kg, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sp_labels, by = "species_code") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sp_label = dplyr::coalesce(sp_label, species_code),
    diff_kg  = observer - selfsampling,
    diff_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      selfsampling > 0,
      round(100 * (observer - selfsampling) / selfsampling, 1),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(pmax(selfsampling, observer))) %>%
  dplyr::select(sp_label, species_code, selfsampling, observer, diff_kg, diff_pct) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    !!txt("col_species") := sp_label,
    !!txt("col_code")    := species_code,
    !!txt("col_ss_kg")   := selfsampling,
    !!txt("col_obs_kg")  := observer,
    !!txt("col_diff_kg") := diff_kg,
    !!txt("col_diff_pct"):= diff_pct
  )

# Total row
total_row <- tbl_species %>%
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(!!txt("col_species") := txt("total_row"), .before = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(!!txt("col_diff_pct") := NA_real_)   # % difference not meaningful for total

tbl_species <- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_species, total_row)
n_data <- nrow(tbl_species) - 1

num_cols <- setdiff(names(tbl_species), txt("col_species"))

ft_sp <- flextable::flextable(tbl_species) %>%
  flextable::set_caption(tab_nums("species_comparison")) %>%
  flextable::bold(part = "header") %>%
  flextable::bold(i = nrow(tbl_species), part = "body") %>%
  flextable::bg(part = "header", bg = pal_header) %>%
  flextable::bg(i = nrow(tbl_species), bg = "#F0F0F0", part = "body") %>%
  flextable::hline_top(part = "header",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E75B6", width = 1.5)) %>%
  flextable::hline_bottom(part = "header",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E75B6", width = 1.5)) %>%
  flextable::hline(i = n_data, part = "body",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E75B6", width = 1.0)) %>%
  flextable::hline_bottom(part = "body",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "#AAAAAA", width = 0.5)) %>%
  flextable::colformat_num(j = c(txt("col_ss_kg"), txt("col_obs_kg"),
                                  txt("col_diff_kg")), big.mark = ",") %>%
  flextable::colformat_num(j = txt("col_diff_pct"), digits = 1, suffix = "%",
                           na_str = "—") %>%
  flextable::align(j = num_cols, align = "right", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::align(j = txt("col_species"), align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  # Highlight rows where difference > 20% in either direction
  flextable::bg(
    i   = ~ !is.na(get(txt("col_diff_pct"))) & abs(get(txt("col_diff_pct"))) > 20,
    j   = txt("col_diff_pct"),
    bg  = "#FFF2CC",
    part = "body"
  ) %>%
  flextable::autofit()

ft_sp
```

<!-- ########################################################################################## -->
<!-- Figure 1: Species composition of landings — self-sampling vs. observer                   -->
<!-- ########################################################################################## -->

```{r fig_species_composition, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}

fig_nums("species_comp", display = FALSE, caption = txt("cap_species_comp"))

if (nrow(comb_totaal_aanvoer) > 0) {

  # Order species by combined total weight across both sources (largest at top)
  sp_order <- comb_totaal_aanvoer %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sp_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(tot = sum(weight_kg), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(tot)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(sp_label)

  source_levels <- c(txt("lbl_selfsampling"), txt("lbl_observer"))

  plot_data <- comb_totaal_aanvoer %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sp_label   = factor(sp_label, levels = rev(sp_order)),
      source_lbl = dplyr::recode(as.character(source),
        selfsampling = txt("lbl_selfsampling"),
        observer     = txt("lbl_observer")),
      source_lbl = factor(source_lbl, levels = source_levels)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sp_label, y = pct, fill = source_lbl)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "none",           # source shown as facet label
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey60"),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, alpha = 0.88) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
              hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = setNames(c(pal_aanvoer, "#E8983A"), source_levels)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20)),
      labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~source_lbl, ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title    = glue("{paste(setvessel, collapse = '/')} — ",
                      "{if (lang == 'nl') 'soortsamenstelling aanvoer' else 'species composition of landings'}"),
      subtitle = glue("{txt('plot_trip_lbl')} {paste(settrip, collapse = ', ')} | ",
                      "{format(report_start, '%d %b')} – {format(report_end, '%d %b %Y')}"),
      x       = if (lang == "nl") "Soort" else "Species",
      y       = txt("ylab_pct"),
      caption = fig_nums("species_comp")
    ) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, face = "italic", hjust = 0))
}
```

<!-- ########################################################################################## -->
<!-- Figure 2: Discards + landings per haul — self-sampling vs. observer                      -->
<!-- ########################################################################################## -->

```{r fig_haul_comparison_setup}
n_hauls_comp <- dplyr::n_distinct(comb_pertrek$haul_id)
fig_h_comp   <- max(5, min(n_hauls_comp * 0.40 + 2.5, 20))
```

```{r fig_haul_comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=fig_h_comp}

fig_nums("haul_comp", display = FALSE, caption = txt("cap_haul_comp"))

if (nrow(comb_pertrek) > 0) {

  source_levels <- c(txt("lbl_selfsampling"), txt("lbl_observer"))
  cat_levels    <- c(txt("lbl_aanvoer"), txt("lbl_discards"))

  plot_pert <- comb_pertrek %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      source_lbl   = dplyr::recode(as.character(source),
        selfsampling = txt("lbl_selfsampling"),
        observer     = txt("lbl_observer")),
      category_lbl = dplyr::recode(as.character(category),
        aanvoer  = txt("lbl_aanvoer"),
        discards = txt("lbl_discards")),
      source_lbl   = factor(source_lbl,   levels = source_levels),
      category_lbl = factor(category_lbl, levels = rev(cat_levels)),
      haul_lbl     = factor(haul_id, levels = rev(sort(unique(haul_id))))
    )

  # ── Per-haul discard % labels (placed at right edge of each stacked bar) ──
  haul_totals <- plot_pert %>%
    dplyr::group_by(source_lbl, haul_lbl) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_kg    = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      discard_kg  = sum(weight_kg[category_lbl == txt("lbl_discards")], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      discard_pct = dplyr::if_else(
        total_kg > 0, round(100 * discard_kg / total_kg), 0L),
      pct_lbl = dplyr::if_else(discard_kg > 0, paste0(discard_pct, "%"), NA_character_)
    )

  # ── Per-trip (per-facet) overall discard % — placed in top-right corner ──
  trip_totals <- plot_pert %>%
    dplyr::group_by(source_lbl) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_kg   = sum(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
      discard_kg = sum(weight_kg[category_lbl == txt("lbl_discards")], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      trip_pct = round(100 * discard_kg / total_kg),
      lbl      = glue(
        "{if (lang == 'nl') 'Totaal discards' else 'Overall discards'}: {trip_pct}%"
      ),
      # x_pos placed near the largest bar in each facet for the annotation
      x_pos = max(haul_totals$total_kg, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.97
    )

  ggplot(plot_pert,
         aes(y = haul_lbl, x = weight_kg, fill = category_lbl)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey60"),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.box         = "horizontal",
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, alpha = 0.88) +
    # Per-haul discard % at the right end of each bar
    geom_text(
      data    = dplyr::filter(haul_totals, !is.na(pct_lbl)),
      aes(y = haul_lbl, x = total_kg, label = pct_lbl),
      hjust   = -0.15, size = 2.6, colour = "grey20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # Overall trip discard % in top-right corner of each facet
    geom_text(
      data    = trip_totals,
      aes(y = Inf, x = x_pos, label = lbl),
      hjust   = 1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold",
      colour  = pal_discards, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name   = if (lang == "nl") "Categorie" else "Category",
      values = setNames(c(pal_aanvoer, pal_discards), cat_levels)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    facet_wrap(~source_lbl, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title    = glue("{paste(setvessel, collapse = '/')} — ",
                      "{if (lang == 'nl') 'aanvoer en discards per trek' else 'landings and discards per haul'}"),
      subtitle = glue("{txt('plot_trip_lbl')} {paste(settrip, collapse = ', ')} | ",
                      "{format(report_start, '%d %b')} – {format(report_end, '%d %b %Y')}"),
      y       = txt("xlab_haul"),
      x       = txt("ylab_weight"),
      caption = fig_nums("haul_comp")
    ) +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, face = "italic", hjust = 0))
}
```
